purpose: Run frozen B0, M1D seeds 0/1/2 and GT oracle on native-mesh LiDAR at V8R-qualified poses, then select one causal topometric-graph parameter tuple from C08 development worlds only.

approval.scope: Implement, preflight, create and execute exactly one immutable route-conditioned C08 causal replay over 4773 frames, 14319 frozen inference frames and 3645 graph replays.
approval.confirmation_reference: After the zero-error/zero-warning preflight, exact cost and evidence were presented and the user replied '继续做', explicitly authorizing continuation into the formal replay.

raw_sources: Three V8R-qualified trajectory archives and the sealed V8R PASS evidence.
Three sealed C08 native meshes, graphs, splines, geometry documents, original teacher trajectories and traversal manifests.
Three frozen M1D checkpoints from the Gate-2 masking-corrective PASS runs.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local C08 development replay only. C09/C10 and M-TARE are excluded; no training, normalization, calibration or checkpoint selection.

sampling.rule: One unique native-mesh sensor frame per sealed route sample. teacher_axis is the original centerline, graph_axis and sensor_xyz are from V8R. The same frames feed B0, three frozen M1D seeds and oracle; method copies and parameter sweeps are not independent samples.

teacher.source: Frozen objective 5m outgoing-direction/branch-count teacher and 10m terminal-first role teacher evaluated only at teacher_axis; GT oracle is an integrity upper bound and cannot be selected.
teacher.valid_mask: Every native scan must be finite, dual-scene deterministic within 1e-6m, have 1..8 branches and complete branch LOS. Native horizontal clearance is diagnostic only; V8R collision/support is the dynamic-safety authority.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Causal graph decisions receive only current/past predicted semantics plus graph/sensor pose. Edge/tunnel/world/future GT remains evaluator-only.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only C08 development worlds select the graph tuple; C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D for 109969920 dual-scene full-scan rays, one RTX 5090 for 14319 frozen inference frames, then CPU for 3645 graph replays; zero training.

evidence.machine_metrics: Three sensor Zarr shards, 4773 frame records, nine M1D outputs, 3645-row sweep, one frozen tuple, 15 selected graphs and decision traces.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Three complete-world role trajectories plus selected graph snapshots and failure evidence if any hard gate stops.
evidence.failure_policy: Any input/environment/checkpoint drift, nonfinite scan, dual-scene or LOS failure, coordinate misuse, oracle-integrity failure or forbidden read seals FAIL; no threshold/grid/model changes or retry.
